findings.finding: Saab's EBIT has beaten consensus three quarters running (EPS surprise +21.7%, +12.3%, +17.6%) and Q2 2026 printed organic growth 29.8%, EBIT +41% to SEK 2,794m at an 11.0% margin and a record gross margin, against a Q3 consensus that only asks for +25.7% revenue and a 9.7% EBIT margin.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Observed report-day closes (Yahoo): Q2'26 2026-07-17 +9.7% on a beat, Q1'26 2026-04-23 +3.8% on a beat, Q4'25 2026-02-05 -1.9% despite a 21% EBIT beat (dividend below consensus), Q3'25 2025-10-24 +6.1% on an in-line EBIT plus a raised 2025 guide.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus for Q3 (EBIT 1,929, margin 9.7%) sits below the Q2 run-rate margin of 11.0%, so the street is applying seasonal caution; if the beat streak were priced the consensus margin would be closer to H1's. Partly priced: the stock rose ~8% 13-16 Oct on the BofA preview.
findings.independence: Baseline consensus history (Yahoo earningsHistory) shows the three beats; https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v10/finance/quoteSummary/SAAB-B.ST?modules=earningsHistory%2CfinancialData

findings.finding: Inderes expects Q3 adj. EBIT of only 1,568 MSEK (8.3% margin, below Q3'25's 8.7%) because Dynamics faces a 19.3% Q3'25 mix-boosted margin comp, Aeronautics carries T-7A start-up costs and A26 ramp is low margin - a sourced reason the seasonal quarter could miss.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3'25 (2025-10-24) EPS 1.77 missed 1.88 and the stock still rose 6.1% on a raised guide; margin softness alone has not been punished in the observed record.
findings.original_quote: För det första möter Dynamics en tuff jämförelseperiod, där marginalerna för Q3'25 (19,3 %) gynnades ... För det tredje förväntar vi oss att Aeronautics fortfarande belastas av uppstartsostnader för T-7A. (Firstly, Dynamics faces a tough comparison, its Q3'25 margins (19.3%) having been boosted ... Thirdly, we expect Aeronautics still to be burdened by T-7A start-up costs.)
findings.why_not_priced: It is inside the published consensus range (low end 1,475), so largely priced as dispersion; filed small because it is one analyst's phasing call and Inderes itself says its full-year is in line with consensus.

findings.finding: Q3 order intake: ~SEK 47.5bn already announced (Ukraine Gripen 24.6bn booked Q3, GlobalEye 10bn, German frigate 8.7bn) against a consensus of 55.6bn; the regular small-order flow (Q3'25 total was 20.9bn) only needs ~8bn for an in-line print, so a modest order beat is more likely than a miss.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2'26 orders 68.4bn (incl. 47bn Polish submarines, pre-announced) coincided with +9.7%; orders are rarely the surprise line because large ones are announced intraquarter.
findings.original_quote: Orderbeloppet motsvarar cirka 24,6 miljarder kronor och ordern kommer att bokas i det tredje kvartalet 2026. (The order value is about SEK 24.6bn and the order will be booked in the third quarter of 2026.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the large orders were each announced and the stock reacted (+3.3% on 2026-07-01). Only the unannounced base flow is open; BofA's 60bn vs Inderes-tabled 55.6bn consensus shows the street has not converged on it.

findings.finding: Operating cash flow should turn more positive in Q3 as advance and milestone payments on the Polish A26 (booked Q2), GlobalEye and Gripen contracts arrive, after H1 operational cash flow of about SEK 1bn and Q2 at SEK -62m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not separable in the observed record; cash conversion target was cut in Feb 2025 and the stock fell 6.2% that day alongside a Ukraine peace-plan headline.
findings.original_quote: Banken räknar med att det fria kassaflödet förbättras markant under andra halvåret 2026 (paraphrase of the telegram as returned; the bank expects free cash flow to improve markedly in H2 2026 on customer advances from large export contracts)
findings.why_not_priced: Cash flow is not in the headline consensus table and has been the stock's recurring complaint; an inference about advance timing, not a company number, so small. The Ukraine contract is EU-loan funded, which makes the advance's quarter uncertain.
findings.independence: https://www.inderes.se/en/analyst-comments/saab-q326-preview-delivery-pace-put-to-the-seasonal-test (advances may turn operating cash flow positive)

baseline_tension: Lean (-0.2, run-up only) and the ~+8% four-session rally into the print cut mildly against a positive lean: the BofA beat case is visibly in the price, so p_up is held near 55 even though the fundamental read (+4% vs the EBIT bar) is positive.
language_note: The Nyhetsbyrån Direkt telegrams on placera.se carried BofA's numbers against consensus (orders +19%, revenue growth 33% vs 26%, EBIT +11%), which the English search returned only as headlines.
Saab's Swedish press release on the Ukraine Gripen contract states the Q3 booking quarter verbatim; the English release says the same - no informational gap there.
The Swedish Inderes preview and its English version carry identical numbers; Börsvärlden (sv) was the clearest source that Saab gives no 2026 annual guide.
Otherwise nothing the English sources did not already carry: Saab publishes every release in both languages at once.
lessons_applied: 'A number the market has already been told is worth 0': order finding cut from +0.4 to +0.2, because ~47.5 of ~56 BSEK is pre-announced.
'Coverage tells you the regime' (>13 analysts, preview is priced): BofA preview finding cut from +0.3 to +0.1.
'Verified fact is not a predicted reaction' plus the Q4'25 case (beat sold on the dividend): beat-streak finding cut from +1.0 to +0.8, p_up 57 -> 55.
'Cash can outweigh': cash-flow finding trimmed +0.4 -> +0.3 with the range kept wide both ways, since the advance timing is inferred.

'The move is in the guide': no guide change expected, but numbers are new and the name's own observed report-day median is ~6%, so abs_move_pct left at 6.0 rather than cut to the 2.3% reiteration base.
